/bin/bash -c "rg -n '"'^## |''^### |generateStaticParams|searchParams|Suspense|connection'"\\(|use cache|cacheLife|dynamicParams|instant = false' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/page.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/generate-static-params.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/cacheLife.md"
